t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The game involves selecting a gnome and basket. The type of the gnome determines which forest will you be led to, either bright or dark, with the orange, green, redd and blue leading you to the bright forest.

vb_textbox.text: This advice contains important points to note, it might be long but worthy going through. The game requires you to choose a gnome from a set of two provided. The selection of these gnomes and the basket has to be swift, roughly under 1.5 seconds. These gnomes will appear in the following sets; orange and brown, green and pink, red and yellow and finally purple and blue. The shapes will be different but this has nothing to do with the number of mushrooms you will collect. Each gnome in a pair will lead you either to a bright forest or dark forest, having red and yellow basket respectively. In addition to that, gnomes which are blue, green, orange and red will lead you to the brighter forest while the rest to a dark forest.Keep your fingers steady and efficient, that way you will collect more mushrooms
